room_theory_algorithm: Verify the accuser is a living non-killer and physically occupies a solution-eligible room.
Set the accused room to the accuser’s current room; the UI cannot name a different room.
Accept one suspected original-killer Character card and one murder-evidence Weapon card.
Block any Character, Weapon, or Room card currently in the accuser’s own evidence hand; an accusation is based on cards the accuser does not have.
Ask every living evidence holder, including bots, to play all named cards they hold. Each played card turns face-up publicly and proves that category choice is not in the envelope.
The original killer has no evidence hand and therefore cannot play a disproof card.
If no living hand plays a card, check the shuffled Gameplay Keep deck containing evidence returned by dead characters.
Reveal every matching Keep-deck card and mark it public; the accusation is disproved if any match exists.
If no living hand and no Keep-deck card can disprove the exact three-card combination, offer the eligible accuser the choice to continue investigating or lock it in as the Final Accusation.
Record all played cards on the public case board and every legal private inference in the accuser’s notebook.

final_accusation.room_validation: The submitted room must equal the room currently occupied by the accuser. Either Library floor counts as the Library.
eligibility: has not used strict final accusation
holds none of the three submitted cards
exact combination was not disproved in the immediately preceding Room Accusation
final_accusation.work_together: The team confirms a shared Final Accusation from the physical room. A wrong strict accusation grants the original killer victory unless forgiving mode is enabled.
final_accusation.free_for_all: Each eligible living non-killer gets one strict Final Accusation. A wrong accuser follows the configured lethal consequence, returns all cards, and becomes a ghost without learning which field was wrong.
final_accusation.correct: Reveal the opening murder reconstruction, the original killer, weapon, victim, and room, then begin the configured Final Confrontation/capture/escape sequence.
final_accusation.killer_restriction: The original killer knows the solution but can never submit it as a winning accusation.
requirements: holds none of the three accused cards
no active meeting or unresolved forced encounter
final_accusation.resolution: Lock the request atomically, compare all three categories to the sealed envelope, then begin the Final Confrontation on a correct result.
final_accusation.wrong_work_together: Apply the configured strict-team failure or remove that accuser’s future accusation eligibility.
final_accusation.wrong_free_for_all: The accuser permanently dies, returns all deck-owned cards, and immediately becomes a ghost.
final_accusation.precheck: Before opening the envelope, repeat the public living-hand and Keep-deck disproof check. If any named card is found, reveal it, record the disproof, and cancel escalation without exposing the envelope.

privacy: The sealed solution stays server-only until a correct Final Accusation or post-match reveal.
Starting evidence hands are private to living non-killer seats.
Legally played disproof cards become public face-up evidence.
Ghosts have no evidence hand and cannot accuse, report, vote, or communicate unrestricted solution information.
The opening victim does not learn the killer merely by entering Ghost Mode.

location_requirement.room_theory: A living, conscious character must physically occupy a legal cell in the named room.
location_requirement.final_accusation: A living, conscious character must physically occupy a legal cell in the accused room.
location_requirement.library: Either Library floor area satisfies the Library location requirement.
location_requirement.not_rooms: Hallways, stairs, service passages, landings, and secret-passage transit cells cannot host a theory or accusation.

not_holding_requirement.rule: The accuser may name only a Character, evidence Weapon, and occupied Room card that are absent from the accuser’s own hand.
not_holding_requirement.client_validation: Disable any card the player holds and reject tampered requests server-side.
not_holding_requirement.reasoning: A player’s own cards already prove those elements are not in the envelope.

room_theory_sequence: A living, conscious character physically enters a solution room and chooses Room Theory.
The current room is filled automatically. The theorist names one Character and one evidence Weapon that are absent from their own hand.
The server validates occupancy, hand restrictions, living status, and unresolved encounter state.
In deterministic seat order, every living human or bot—including the original killer—who holds one or more named cards must play every matching card face-up into the public Disproof Zone.
The server also checks the protected Keep deck for matching cards returned by later dead characters and plays every match.
After the reveal window, played cards return to the correct private hand or protected Keep deck; the public case board records each disproved element.
If no card is played, mark an Unrefuted Lead and offer the theorist the option to escalate to a Final Accusation if otherwise eligible.
bot_behavior: Bots, including a killer bot, maintain private five-card evidence hands, refuse theories containing their own cards, and automatically play every required matching card.
ghost_rule: Ghosts cannot make theories, play living evidence cards, or accuse.

killer_evidence_rule.server_enforcement: A matching killer card is auto-committed to the Disproof Zone under the same timing and animation as every other matching card.
killer_evidence_rule.privacy: The reveal identifies the card owner seat, not that seat’s secret role.
killer_evidence_rule.final_accusation: The original killer cannot make a Final Accusation.
